description: Final service split for the gitlab provider. The generator assigns each mapped inventory row to a service: the 'overrides' map (keyed by proposed_resource) wins, otherwise the inventory's proposed_service (from SERVICE_RULES in lib/schema_walk.mjs) is used. Services not in 'services' fail generation; 'descriptions' feed provider.yaml and the service doc info blocks.

descriptions.projects: Projects and project-scoped configuration - project details, forks, topics, labels, milestones, releases, environments, deployments, branch rules, repository and statistics.
descriptions.groups: Groups, namespaces and group-scoped resources - group details, descendant and shared groups, members, epics, iterations, contacts and organizations.
descriptions.users: Users and access - user details, the current user, user permissions on projects and groups, and to-do items.
descriptions.issues: Issues and time tracking - project and group issues, issue status counts, issue access levels and timelogs.
descriptions.merge_requests: Merge requests - project and group merge requests, merge request details, violations and access levels.
descriptions.ci: CI/CD - pipelines, jobs, runners, pipeline schedules, pipeline analytics, CI variables, job token scope and CI/CD settings.
descriptions.work_items: Work items - group work items, work item types and state counts.
descriptions.security: Security and compliance - vulnerabilities, vulnerability statistics and scanners, security policies, dependencies (SBOM), DAST profiles and compliance frameworks.
descriptions.packages: Packages and registries - packages, container repositories, container protection rules, dependency proxy and cleanup policies.
descriptions.boards: Issue and epic boards - project, group and instance boards and board lists.
descriptions.metadata: Instance metadata - GitLab version and revision, current license and query complexity.
descriptions.analytics: Analytics - usage trends, DevOps adoption, value streams, DORA performance scores, code coverage, contributions and customizable dashboards.
descriptions.admin: Administration - Geo nodes, license history, subscription entries and billable user previews.
descriptions.duo: GitLab Duo - AI chat context presets and agentic workflows.
